pages.title: Stone of the Dead
pages.text: $(curse)Necrostone$() is found in tombs and places of death. Its dark surface absorbs light, creating an ominous atmosphere.$(br2)$(warning)Warning:$() Extended contact may attract unwanted attention from the underworld.
